sequential_context: The global format-only prompt reduced Travel zero-tool failures from 36 to 14 but reduced clean utility from 2/45 to 1/45. All 36 base zero-tool failures occurred on the first assistant turn, and many contain an explicit but malformed function call.
hypothesis: A deterministic parser that accepts only an unambiguous function name plus JSON arguments can recover executable calls while leaving the base prompt, sampled tokens, and task reasoning unchanged.

accepted_additional_forms: bare JSON with name or function plus parameters or arguments
split function-name tag followed by JSON
function name and JSON inside one tag
constraints: JSON arguments must be an object
function name must match an active FunctionsRuntime tool
keep only the first valid call
never infer a function from prose

offline_precheck.source: 36 Travel clean utility failures with zero parsed tool calls under base function_tags

fixed_clean_only_budget_if_precheck_pass.baseline: strict base function_tags with identical task and seed pairs

claim_boundary: This is a sequential clean-only parser repair. It changes no generated text and cannot justify attack generation or Dreamer training unless the paired clean gate is met.
